DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('Dim_Tiempo'[anio])),
			AND('Dim_Tiempo'[anio] IN {2025}, 'Dim_Tiempo'[anio] <> 1900)
		)

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'Dim_Tiempo'[trimestre],
			__DS0FilterTable,
			"Ventas_Totales", 'Fact_Ventas_Envios'[Ventas Totales]
		)

	VAR __DS0IntersectionCount = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(__DS0Core))

	VAR __DS0BodyBinnedSample = 
		SAMPLEAXISWITHLOCALMINMAX(3500, __DS0Core, 'Dim_Tiempo'[trimestre], [Ventas_Totales], 350, , ALPHABETICAL, ASC, 105000, 60)

EVALUATE
	ROW(
	"DS0IntersectionCount", __DS0IntersectionCount
)

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyBinnedSample

ORDER BY
	'Dim_Tiempo'[trimestre]

	VAR __DS0BodyBinnedSample =

DEFINE
	VAR __H0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({"CALLAO"}, 'Dim_Ubicacion'[departamento])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('Dim_Tiempo'[anio])),
			AND('Dim_Tiempo'[anio] IN {2025}, 'Dim_Tiempo'[anio] <> 1900)
		)

	VAR __DS0FilterTable2 = 
		TREATAS({"DEPORTES"}, 'Dim_Producto'[categoria])

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'Dim_Producto'[categoria],
			__DS0FilterTable,
			__DS0FilterTable2,
			"Ventas_Totales", 'Fact_Ventas_Envios'[Ventas Totales],
			"Fact_Ventas_EnviosVentas_Totales", IGNORE(CALCULATE('Fact_Ventas_Envios'[Ventas Totales], KEEPFILTERS(__H0FilterTable)))
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [Ventas_Totales], 0, 'Dim_Producto'[categoria], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[Ventas_Totales] DESC, 'Dim_Producto'[categoria]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('Dim_Tiempo'[anio])),
			AND('Dim_Tiempo'[anio] IN {2025}, 'Dim_Tiempo'[anio] <> 1900)
		)

	VAR __DS0FilterTable2 = 
		TREATAS({"DEPORTES"}, 'Dim_Producto'[categoria])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable3 = 
		TREATAS({"CALLAO"}, 'Dim_Ubicacion'[departamento])

EVALUATE
	SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
		__DS0FilterTable,
		__DS0FilterTable2,
		__DS0FilterTable3,
		"Ventas_Totales", IGNORE('Fact_Ventas_Envios'[Ventas Totales]),
		"Numero_Pedidos", IGNORE('Fact_Ventas_Envios'[Numero Pedidos]),
		"Ticket_Promedio", IGNORE('Fact_Ventas_Envios'[Ticket Promedio]),
		"Tasa_Cancelacion", IGNORE('Fact_Ventas_Envios'[Tasa Cancelacion])
	)
